title: The Days of the Week
summary: The seven days of the week met in a grand assembly. Monday boasted of honest labor; Tuesday of energy; Wednesday of commerce; Thursday of planning; Friday of preparation; Saturday...
full_text:
The seven days of the week met in a grand assembly. Monday boasted of honest labor; Tuesday of energy; Wednesday of commerce; Thursday of planning; Friday of preparation; Saturday of clean hearths; and Sunday of holy rest and fellowship.

They joined hands in a harmonious dance, proving that all days are united in building the sanctuary of human life.
moral: Every day brings its own duty and opportunity to serve and love.
